claim: The boundary rule for loopback in Nix builds: a server started OUTSIDE the build is unreachable from inside checkPhase (different netns loopbacks), but a server started INSIDE the build (as a test fixture) works on Linux — the same author demonstrated both directions (Discourse 40208 + nixpkgs PR #283878).
stance_target: gap-04: the harness must spawn mosquitto as a subprocess of the test inside the sandbox, not connect to any host service — the design as written is correct
scope_conditions: Nix sandbox = true on Linux, 2024; curl/python http.server
quoted_support: the loopback interface inside the build sandbox is not the same one my example python server is listening to external to that context
